description: Amp Fiddler first released ‘Energy’ in 2014 as part of his ‘Basementality’ series (named ‘Basementailty’ as he was always creating music via his ‘Camp Amp’ basement studio). Limited to a Bandcamp only release at the time, Amp recently reissued ‘Basementality Volumes 2 & 3’ for availability on all digital streaming platforms to give the music fresh love, adding the remixes for an extra slice of rejuvenation.
